title: Return Noble USDC escrow to the migration multisig and freeze the Terra USDC voucher
summary: Circle ends USDC support on Noble; the full pause is on 2027-01-12. This proposal returns all Noble USDC vouchers (ibc/2C962DAB9F57FE0921435426AE75196009FAA1981BF86991203C8411F8980FDB) still in circulation on Terra to Noble over channel-253 (MsgReturnToNoble, amount 0 = the full return cap), releasing the matching USDC from Noble escrow to the multisig noble1REPLACE_WITH_MULTISIG. In the same execution it disables bank sends of the voucher, so the holder snapshot is the height emitted by the usdcmigration_return_to_noble event. Holders are repaid off-chain from that snapshot: REPLACE_WITH_REPAYMENT_PLAN_URL.
